description_en: Queries the blockchain metadata of uploaded data
description_zh: 用于查询上传数据的区块链元信息
name: GetBlockChainInfo

parameters.help_en: The API version number. Set the value to "1.0.0"
parameters.name: api_version

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the data key
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en:
The user business ID. For the same key, the business ID must be unique. The value is a 64-character string. Valid characters: [0-9,a-f,A-F].
If this parameter is not specified, the latest data for the current key is returned
parameters.help_zh:
用户业务ID，同一个Key，业务ID必须唯一。格式为64字符，合法字符范围[0-9,a-f,A-F]。
如果不包含该参数，则返回当前Key最新数据
parameters.name: business_id

Data.description_en: The blockchain metadata corresponding to the unique identifier key, in JSON format. For more information, see the blockChainInfo table below
Data.description_zh: 返回唯一标识key对应的区块链元数据信息（JSON格式）。详情请参见下表blockChainInfo
Data.example: {"blockChainInfo":{"chainName":"某公司业务链","blockHeight":48971,"transactionHash":"ea8752787f79be085d9ee244a1b9ed0deb198903a14b9b1a6800b20fbf0d****","iotId":"1BE0F46275B17147E7D2****","endorsementNames":"某公司,某某公司","timestamp":"1591676312000","blockHash":"d07bdaf2736c4d07bdaf2736e5faae508d77ceb82c0e9722a8bcca0e909e****","previousHash":"c4d07bdaf2736cc0ec0e909e60e5c21dc14d0eb823eb82f4f99791c4d07b****","dataHash":"21dc1288bcc0e2730ae486fa04fdeb828ae5c21dc128c525a655972e5faa****"}}

Message.example: The system is busy. Please try again later.

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
